subject: Rebaseline MAP & request for credit escrow due to cutover slip
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Pierce <tpierce@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Rebaseline MAP & request for credit escrow due to cutover slip

Tom — thanks for the sync this morning. Per our conversation I’m attaching an updated risk register and a proposed MAP rebaseline. High level: the attempted production cutover on Friday hit the known DB migration race; your engineering team paused the rollout and requested an additional QA window. That pushes the agreed delivery window beyond the current acceptance date.

Attachments: nimble_risk_register_v2.xlsx, nimble_updated_map_v1.pdf

Action items I’m proposing here so we’re aligned and I can take approvals internally:
- Rebaseline acceptance date to 2026-09-13 (two-week QA + one-week buffer).
- Put a small credit escrow on the table to cover the delayed acceptance window (goodwill; amount TBD).
- Amend the MAP milestones: move final validation to the week of 9/6, hold cutover dry run on 8/30.

Please confirm the new dates and whether your procurement team needs a formal escrow request or a DocuSign amendment. If you confirm today I’ll loop in Finance and Legal for a quick approval path.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Vanessa — thanks for the summary and for pulling the register together.

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 9:13 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tom — thanks for the sync this morning. Per our conversation I’m attaching an updated risk register and a proposed MAP rebaseline. High level: the attempted production cutover on Friday hit the known DB migration race; your engineering team paused the rollout and requested an additional QA window. That pushes the agreed delivery window beyond the current acceptance date.
> 
> Attachments: nimble_risk_register_v2.xlsx, nimble_updated_map_v1.pdf
> 

We can accept the rebaseline dates you proposed but Procurement is asking for two things before they will sign the amended MAP: 1) a formal escrow/credit note showing the proposed credit amount, and 2) assurance that the dry run on 8/30 will have a rollback plan and a named on-call contact. Both are reasonable.

A couple more details from our side: the failed cutover also exposed a downstream job that will require a small patch; our SREs estimate that patch will take 3 business days to validate. Given internal budget windows we need the escrow note in DocuSign (our procurement cannot process verbal commitments). If you can get a redline to the current SOW + a DocuSign amendment by EOD tomorrow we’ll try to move fast.

Tom
Tom Pierce
Director, IT Operations — Nimble Health
tpierce@nimblehealth.com | +1 212-555-0789

Attachment referenced: internal patch summary (sent separately)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebaseline MAP & request for credit escrow due to cutover slip

Vanessa / Marissa — quick internal note.

1) I’m OK to approve a nominal credit escrow (up to $25k) as a customer-success gesture to keep momentum, provided Finance signs off.
2) Marissa — can you draft a one-page escalation memo for Finance & Legal that: a) summarizes the cutover failure, b) requests approval for escrow up to $25k, and c) includes the updated MAP with proposed dates? We should include the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign envelope placeholder (see thread links).
3) If Procurement requires more than $25k or wants a contract language change beyond an amendment, escalate to me and Vanessa for exec approval.

Short reply from me: green to proceed to drafting & internal approval path.

–Rishi
VP, Sales Ops (covering enterprise approvals)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Pierce <tpierce@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebaseline MAP & request for credit escrow due to cutover slip

Tom — appreciate the quick response and clear asks. Next steps from our side:

- Marissa will send a one-page escalation memo to Finance & Legal this morning (includes the incident summary, updated MAP, and escrow ask capped at $25k).
- I’ll prepare a DocuSign amendment with the redline to the SOW and the proposed credit language; I’ll mark the DocuSign as "Escrow: up to $25k" to match Rishi’s approval. Link to be provided when ready.
- We’ll confirm the 8/30 dry run will have a named on-call (Samantha Li, eng lead) and a rollback plan; engineering will circulate runbook by 8/27.

Tentative timeline: internal approvals by 8/3 EOD, DocuSign to Nimble by 8/4 EOD, dry run 8/30, final validation week of 9/6, acceptance target 9/13.

If Procurement needs a different escrow mechanism (letter of credit vs credit memo) flag it in your reply and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this with minimal disruption.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
